761450301.text: Oh my, I can't believe they're all sold out! Looks like I do have some business sense after all.

761450302.text: Next, I'll ask the Lightkeepers to guide me through the Dreadshade Mire. After that, it should be a straight shot to the north.

761450303.text: Maybe I'll find some business opportunities on my way back... Well then, this is where we part. Until we meet again!

761450401.text: What a coincidence, we meet again! Would you like to buy something? My new stock isn't moving at all... please, help me out here.

761450408.text: These are all local specialties. Don't worry, I'll give you the very best price!

761450403.text: Well, you know how it is — business is business. Strike while the iron's hot, right? I came across a good opportunity in Piramida, someone needed to sell their goods urgently and gave me a good price.

761450404.text: I got a little too excited and forgot I was supposed to be heading home... so I bought everything. And now, here I am...

761450405.text: Guess why he's in such a hurry to sell.

761450406.text: Agh, please don't rub it in... Why not have a look instead? Maybe you'll find something useful.

761450410.text: Hey... don't leave yet! I'm sure there's something you need!

761450601.text: Great! Finally sold everything. Looks like the old "small profit, quick turnover" strategy really works.

761450602.text: By rights, I should be heading back to Snezhnaya... though right now I've barely made enough for the journey. I came here empty-handed, and I'd rather not go back the same way!

761450603.text: *sigh* Anyway, thanks for supporting my business.

761450701.text: Oh my, fate works in mysterious ways — running into you here again! Want to take a look? This time I've got some pretty good stuff.

761450710.text: Hey, all of this is retired equipment the Fatui got rid of. You won't find it anywhere else, so take whatever you like!

761450703.text: To be honest, my home is in Novokitezhgrad, and my whole family works in the mines. They are all more stubborn than the Domovoy, and when I said I wanted to go into business, they were dead set against it.

761450704.text: So before I left, I made a big promise to make a fortune... But who would've thought I'd end up barely able to scrape together enough money for the journey back.

761450705.text: Making it big is out of the question now, but at least let me earn a little — something to show for when I get back.

761450707.text: Oh, come on! I'm a law-abiding Snezhnayan, and being around the Fatui here feels just like being at home.

761450708.text: All my goods here are retired equipment the Fatui got rid of, and they specifically asked me to handle it. You won't find anything like this anywhere else, this is the only place.

761450901.text: Thank you so much, really... thank you! Thanks to you, I won't have to go back looking so miserable!

761450902.text: This is really goodbye. You've bought so much from me — guess that makes us friends now.

761450903.text: If you ever get the chance to come to Snezhnaya, come find me in Novokitezhgrad. See you next time!

761450101.text: Business really is terrible these days... Maybe I should save up some money and try to rent a stall in Nasha Town...

761450114.text: Just some trinkets I got from Natlan, feel free to take a look if anything interests you.

761450103.text: Oh my, a customer! Hello there! I'm Kuzmich, a traveling merchant from Snezhnaya.

761450104.text: Well, that's what I like to call myself, but I'm just doing a bit of small business on my travels to earn some money for the journey.

761450105.text: But when I passed through Natlan, the people there were just too enthusiastic, and I got caught up in the moment and... Now if I don't sell all this merchandise, I won't even have enough money for a ticket back home.

761450116.text: Hey, why are you leaving already? Won't you take a look...
